description: The file shapes of atlax, the platform's copy of the Atlas norm (~/agent-slack/docs/atlas/manifesto.md; implementation.md steps 1-2 and Layout; decisions.md 2026-10-31). Every sample below holds to its schema; test.py checks each, and a missing sample or schema fails, never skips. The example artifact is the mailbox (agent-mailbox-api, the mailbox); the example consumer is Deltagos (agent-organizer).

samples.what: one element file, atlax/elements/<designation>.yaml in an artifact repo
an element in another artifact whose consumes: reads ext:agent-mailbox-api#fn:mailbox.threads.list
an element of kind wails: a Go method bound to Deltagos's frontend (binding, types-only signature), as atlax derive reads it
an element of kind cli: an organizer subcommand, authored (contract and test)
an http element whose pattern names no method: terminal.method ANY (atlax-tool-followups U7)
atlax/overrides.yaml: what the Wails and CLI extractors are told when the shape cannot be read
atlax/plant.yaml, the artifact's nameplate
a nameplate with extract (route wrappers, excluded test helpers) and test (build tags), modelled on the record (atlax-tool-followups U5, U8)
the stamp of a published folder
the stamp of a folder whose derived/map.json atlax publish made from the slice (map: derived; atlax-tool-followups U10)
the nameplate as published
a published element (http, authored, live)
a published element (http, authored, live)
a published rule: R1 (429) live, R2 (503) planned, each naming its test
derived/map.json, the initiative's map.json at publish, as committed (c4-map/1, unchanged)
the body a starting card posts to Hestia's claims
atlax verify --json: redline, shadow, book-guard, row-test, ext-break
atlax check --json: ext-break, consumer-notice
the body that releases a claim, keyed by card + artifact
counts only, from a factory whose book stays on its side
platform/artifacts.yaml in the atlax repo: the artifacts atlax-watch polls (slug + remote)
one claims file of a laptop (atlax claim / release): atlax_claim and atlax_claim_released facts, each body per the claim and claim-release samples
Hestia's GET /v1/claims/overlaps?factory= answer: the asked factory's open claims that share designations with another open claim (only the shared ones)

published_folder.lands_at: artifacts/<artifact>/ in the atlax repo (ATLAX_REPO, cloned at ATLAX_DIR)

writers: the artifact's FSE, Daedalus and builders: element files and plant.yaml, through a card's change order
claudecode bin/atlax (card atlax-tool): PUBLISHED, derived/, verify and check findings
the card's start (factory side): the claim
claudecode bin/atlax claim, release, publish (card atlax-agent): the claims files (claims-state)
atlax-agent, by a platform/ PR it merges itself: platform/artifacts.yaml
readers: claudecode bin/atlax verify, publish, check (card atlax-tool T1-T7): no test reads this folder yet
Hestia's claims API (a Hestia card): no test reads claim.sample.json yet
atlax-agent, the Deltagos map lens, Elenx C4, Daedalus: no test reads it yet
claudecode bin/atlax-watch (card atlax-agent G1): platform/artifacts.yaml; claudecode tests/atlax t8-t11 check what atlax writes against these samples
the record's laptop indexer (hestia's card atlax-claims): the claims files; no test reads them yet

claudecode bin/atlax verify, touches, derive (card atlax-wails-extractor W1-W4): kinds wails and cli, atlax/overrides.yaml; tests/atlax t16-t17 check the fixture's element files and overrides against these schemas

claudecode bin/atlax verify, touches, derive, publish, check, claim, card-check (card atlax-tool-followups U1-U13): plant extract and test, method ANY, the undeclared finding, PUBLISHED map, claim claimed_at; tests/atlax t18-t24 check what atlax writes against these schemas

must_refuse.reason: the IEC symbol is never written: one spelling (decisions.md 2026-10-31, item 2)
an authored terminal names its contract sample and its test
a wails element names its binding and its signature
a cli element names its command
a wails ignore is Struct.Method, an exported method
a wails bind is dir:Type
a binding outside package main is go.<pkg>.Struct.Method, as Wails exposes it
every row of a rule names its test
maturity is binary (authored) for now; no middle levels
consumes: is ext:<artifact>#<designation>
an instance declares the norm it follows
the artifact id is the repo slug: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
a short sha cannot be compared with main
Hestia holds names only, never element content
Hestia holds names only, never element content
a row-test finding names its row, test and result
check never raises verify's kinds
a release is keyed by card + artifact
counts only: no designation
counts only: no list of names
every row names the remote the watcher polls
the slug is the repo slug, not a path or URL
notify's to is a slug and subject_prefix plain: they go into a command
notify names the cell and the recipient
a fact is one of the two claim kinds
an http terminal names its method; a pattern with no method is ANY (atlax-tool-followups U7)
the any-method spelling is ANY, never * or an empty string
a route wrapper is a function or receiver.method name as written at the call, not a call
extract holds go_route_wrappers and exclude only
a build tag is one word, never flags for go test
map is said only when not the initiative's: derived or none
claimed_at is UTC, the fact's at
an undeclared route is information, never blocking
